title: Titanic survivor's account of angels in a craft by the lifeboats

tellings.quote: Titanic, it described a group of angels who came in a craft land one of the lifeboats and landed on the ledge of one of the icebergs

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent years with tall white aliens while serving in the Air Force, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a book about the Titanic, the ocean liner that sank in the North Atlantic in 1912. Hall says the book describes a survivor, picked up by the rescue ship Carpathia, who reported a group of angels arriving in a craft near the lifeboats and landing on the ledge of an iceberg. Hall tells it as an early sign of such beings, described in the language of the time.
